Fields.Name: Animation Bundle Name
Fields.Description: The animation bundle the animation is in. Empty: the character's default bundle.

Fields.Name: Animation Name
Fields.Description: The animation the clip plays (aXXX_YYYYYY). The row below shows whether the character has a time act entry and an animation file for it.

Fields.Name: User Partition Mask
Fields.Description: Which bone partitions the clip animates (bits). 0 for all.

Fields.Name: Crop Start Amount (Local Time)
Fields.Description: Seconds cut from the start of the animation.

Fields.Name: Crop End Amount (Local Time)
Fields.Description: Seconds cut from the end of the animation.

Fields.Name: Start Time
Fields.Description: Where playback starts, in seconds from the (cropped) start.

Fields.Name: Playback Speed
Fields.Description: The playback rate: 1 is normal speed, 2 double, a negative value plays backwards.

Fields.Name: Enforced Duration
Fields.Description: Scales the playback so the clip lasts this many seconds. 0 to play at its own length.

Fields.Name: User Controlled Time Fraction
Fields.Description: The playback position, as a fraction of the duration (0 to 1), when the mode is User Controlled. Usually bound to a variable.

Fields.Name: Animation Binding Index
Fields.Description: The index of the animation binding in the character's animation set (set at runtime). -1 for none.

Fields.Name: Playback Mode
Fields.Description: How the animation plays: once, looping, user controlled (by User Controlled Time Fraction) or ping-pong (forward then backward).

Fields.Name: Playback Flags
Fields.Description: Playback options: continue motion at end, sync half cycle in ping-pong mode, mirror, force dense pose, keep annotations from becoming triggers, ignore motion.

Fields.Name: User Data
Fields.Description: A value for the game's own use; Havok doesn't read it.

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: The node's name. Used to find it in the outline and in the action scripts; it doesn't have to be unique.

Fields.Name: Variable Bindings
Fields.Description: The bindings that drive this object's fields from behavior variables or character properties each frame.

Fields.Name: Triggers
Fields.Description: Events the clip sends at set times of its animation.
